description: Install lucide-react and create foundational icon + motion utilities. Sets up tech-to-icon mapping (TECH_ICONS, CATEGORY_ICONS) and CSS motion classes (hover-transition, card-hover, tech-tag-hover, featured-pulse, slide-in-cascade) with prefers-reduced-motion support. Foundation for all icon-aware components.
steps: Install lucide-react: `bun add lucide-react` in client/. Verify no peer dependency errors.

Create client/src/lib/techStackIcons.ts with TECH_ICONS map (React, TypeScript, Node.js, PostgreSQL, Python, FastAPI, Bun, WebSocket, Redis, Docker, AWS, Tailwind, Transformers), CATEGORY_ICONS map (fullstack, ai_ml, backend, frontend, experiment), and getTechIcon(tech) / getCategoryIcon(category) helpers that return {icon: LucideIcon, color: string, label: string} or fallback.

Update client/src/styles/globals.css: add CSS custom properties for spacing grid (--spacing-2 through --spacing-24), and @layer utilities for .hover-transition (200ms expo-out), .card-hover (border amber/shadow/scale), .tech-tag-hover (border amber/bg amber-10/scale), .featured-pulse (2s infinite pulse), .slide-in-cascade (300ms ease-out with nth-child 50ms stagger). All wrapped in @media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference).
acceptance_criteria: `bun list lucide-react` shows installed version, no warnings
techStackIcons.ts exports getTechIcon, getCategoryIcon, TECH_ICONS, CATEGORY_ICONS, no unused imports
globals.css has motion utilities, CSS custom properties defined, no syntax errors
verification: Run `cd client && bun list lucide-react` — confirms installed
Run `cd client && bun run typecheck` — 0 errors
Run `cd client && bun run build` — build succeeds, dist/ contains client bundles
Inspect dist/index.html and dist/assets/*.js — no Lucide warnings in console, bundle includes icon tree-shaking
findings: Icon system foundation complete. All 13 tech icons + 5 category icons implemented with correct colors as specified. Motion utilities (hover-transition 200ms expo-out, card-hover with scale 1.02 + shadow, tech-tag-hover with scale 1.05, featured-pulse 2s infinite, slide-in-cascade 300ms with 50ms stagger) ready for component integration. CSS custom properties for spacing grid available. FEAT-002 should focus on integrating icons into ProjectCard, ProjectFilters, ProjectMeta components using getTechIcon() and getCategoryIcon() helpers.
